gloss: mole under the eye; beauty mark

definitions.gloss: mole under the eye; beauty mark
definitions.explanation: A mole just below the eye, where a tear would fall. It is often thought to give a face a gentle or alluring look.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{泣|な}きぼくろ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: She has a beauty mark under her eye.

examples.japanese: ⟦{右目|みぎめ}→右目：29956_migime⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{下|した}→下：00670_shita⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{泣|な}きぼくろ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{印象的|いんしょうてき}→印象的：15547_inshouteki⟧だ。
examples.english: The mole under her right eye is striking.

examples.japanese: {泣|な}きぼくろ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{涙|なみだ}もろい⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{言|い}われる→言う：00515_iu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦もちろん→もちろん：01224_mochiron⟧⟦{根拠|こんきょ}→根拠：10147_konkyo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧。
examples.english: People with a mole under the eye are said to cry easily, but of course there is no basis for it.

notes:
⟦{泣|な}く→泣く：00655_naku⟧ (to cry) + ほくろ (mole). Manga and anime artists often give a character one as a mark of charm.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {泣|な}きぼくろ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧: to have a mole under the eye
- ⟦{目元|めもと}→目元：23407_memoto⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{泣|な}きぼくろ: a mole near the eye
